data.name: Wagonlight: Tales of Mossvale
data.detailed_description:
Wagonlight: Tales of Mossvale

Travel the old roads of a cozy storybook fantasy realm in Wagonlight: Tales of Mossvale, a merchant adventure about trade, travel, friendship, and finding warmth at the edge of the map.

You are not the chosen hero. You are the traveling merchant people hope to see before winter comes — the one who brings warm blankets to snowbound villages, candles to darkened halls, medicine to sick towns, rare tea to lonely inns, and hope to the folk waiting at the end of forgotten roads.

Load your wagon, care for your pony, study your handwritten map, and set out across forests, hills, mountain passes, village markets, and lantern-lit inns. Buy low, sell smart, deliver precious goods, help villagers in need, and build your name as the most beloved merchant in Mossvale.

Every road has a story. Every village has a need. Every lantern leads you home.

A Cozy Fantasy Merchant Adventure

In Wagonlight, the heart of the journey is not conquest — it is connection. Visit warm villages, barter in bustling markets, rest beside glowing hearths, share tea after the rain, and become part of the world one delivery at a time.

Trade, Travel, and Survive the Road

Plan your route carefully. Safe roads may take longer, while shortcuts through forests and mountain passes can bring danger, lost time, or rare opportunities. Weather, broken wheels, hungry animals, bandits, strange travelers, and hidden paths all shape the journey.

Build Your Wagon Home

Your wagon is more than storage — it is your traveling home. Upgrade it with lanterns, better shelves, cozy interiors, weatherproof covers, extra cargo space, tea stations, herb racks, and warm little comforts that make every journey feel personal.

Help the People of Mossvale

Each village remembers what you do. Bring medicine before sickness spreads, deliver candles before the long dark nights, carry blankets before the snow arrives, or bring rare treats to lonely inns. Your reputation grows through kindness, fair trade, and brave journeys.

Quick, Cozy Tactical Encounters

Danger waits on the old roads. Defend your wagon from goblins, wolves, thieves, and roadside trouble in small tactical encounters where protecting your wares matters as much as winning the fight.

Features

  • Travel a beautiful hand-painted storybook fantasy realm

  • Buy, sell, barter, and deliver goods between villages

  • Plan routes using a handwritten fantasy map

  • Visit cozy inns, markets, forests, hills, and mountain roads

  • Upgrade and decorate your traveling wagon home

  • Build trust and reputation with villages across Mossvale

  • Experience changing seasons, weather, road events, and local needs

  • Defend your wagon in short tactical battles

  • Meet villagers, travelers, storytellers, innkeepers, and companions

  • Become the merchant people are always happy to see

Wagonlight: Tales of Mossvale is a warm fantasy journey about carrying more than goods. You carry comfort, stories, and hope.
